verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a fair question for an API platform, but nothing in the evidence shows any documented capability to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The Batch API ([gpt-docs-8]) covers one-off asynchronous submissions with a 24-hour turnaround, not a recurring schedule. Agent orchestration and the managed Codex harness ([gpt-docs-10], [gpt-docs-27]) mention no cron or scheduled triggers, so none of these count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
